report:
Top finding: no nonsecurity implementation or result blocker was found in the exact 23,252-byte eleven-API candidate. This is a narrow implementation/result pass only; positions is empty and no cryptographic, proof, hash-security, VK, ledger-truth or hostile-policy judgment is supplied. The separate fresh Opus cryptographic/security combined audit remains pending and is not approved or substituted here.

The four Sol Data factories match the frozen DF contract and API by full source inspection. _data_bytes and _data_integer enforce exact builtin bytes/int before length or range operations, so bool and subclasses are refused. build_value_data preserves input order, groups only maximal same-policy runs, keeps a zero-lovelace ada entry, omits it for None, enforces at most 256 token rows and checks each row completely before the strictly-ascending tokens.order check. build_output_reference returns the exact constr-0 reference. build_env_data checks fields in parameter order and returns the fixed version 2, claim-kind 0 and 32-byte family envelope with a fresh nested constr-0 settle reference. build_c2_mint_data returns Issue as constr 0 with opaque vk then proof and Burn as constr 1 with both payloads required to be None. All refusal messages are fixed path-prefixed text, returns use fresh lists created by the call, arguments are not mutated, and the suffix adds no import and calls no encoder, hash, statement, financial or native helper.

Preserved-prefix integration also holds in the inspected combined source. The suffix introduces only _data_bytes, _data_integer and the four public factories and does not rebind prefix names; the eleven public APIs are present. Encoder, wire-request and statement code retain their prior structure, including exact-type checks, closed schemas, detached copies, statement admission order and fixed header offsets. Matching canonical expected Data and published digest/public-input literals is recorded only as literal test-fact alignment, not as certification of cryptography.

The pinned root receipt is internally consistent: 13 Data + 19 statement + 31 request + 19 encoder equals 82 passes, each bounded and ordinary, with isolated files and candidate bytes unchanged afterwards. Prior Data RED 1+12 and statement RED 2+17 explain the earlier missing-implementation state; author-time unrun/unread records are not current results. The encoder selection honestly excludes the one historical phase-1 absence method under I1-SCOPE; the only loader change admits exactly unaliased import hashlib and does not alter the other 19 behaviour checks or vectors.

Helper behaviour must not be confused with missing external stages. This candidate does not establish a JSON byte parser, native Rust parse/from_records round-trip, compiler or VK correspondence, compiled Aiken/VM round-trip, ScriptContext or ledger fit, transaction assembly, fees/min-ADA, deployment, or public verification. Context remains caller-supplied and unauthenticated, Groth16 setup context remains a local single-party test profile, and Preview-first plus later Preprod acceptance remain separate obligations. Assets, dict, groth16 and worktree-types sources qualify DF-13 context but do not close compiled or ledger correspondence, and the omitted generic build_inputs consumer means Value consumer wiring is not approved.
